description: This file defines the ChallengeService class which manages challenge operations, validation, and observers within a security/authentication context. It includes methods for creating challenges, validating challenge responses, managing challenge lifecycle, and observer notifications.

classes.name: ChallengeService
classes.description: Main class managing challenge creation, validation, observers, and lifecycle.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up references and calls superclass deinit.

methods.name: promptForChallengeResponse
methods.description: Prompts user for challenge response and returns a promise with the response.

methods.name: createChallenge
methods.description: Creates a new Challenge instance with prompts, reason, and optional UI strings.

methods.name: validateChallengeValue
methods.description: Validates a challenge value based on its validation mode.

methods.name: promptForCorrectPasscode
methods.description: Prompts user to enter the correct passcode.

methods.name: promptForAccountPassword
methods.description: Prompts user for account password if account exists.

methods.name: getWrappingKeyIfApplicable
methods.description: Retrieves the wrapping key if passcode is available, handling user prompts.

methods.name: isPasscodeLocked
methods.description: Checks if the passcode is currently locked.

methods.name: addChallengeObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for a specific challenge.

methods.name: createOrGetChallengeOperation
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an existing challenge operation.

methods.name: performOnObservers
methods.description: Performs a callback on all observers of a challenge.

methods.name: onChallengeValidValue
methods.description: Notifies observers of a valid challenge value.

methods.name: onChallengeInvalidValue
methods.description: Notifies observers of an invalid challenge value.

methods.name: onChallengeNonvalidatedSubmit
methods.description: Notifies observers of a non-validated challenge submission.

methods.name: onChallengeComplete
methods.description: Notifies observers of challenge completion.

methods.name: onChallengeCancel
methods.description: Notifies observers of challenge cancellation.

methods.name: getChallengeOperation
methods.description: Retrieves the challenge operation by challenge ID.

methods.name: deleteChallengeOperation
methods.description: Deletes a challenge operation.

methods.name: cancelChallenge
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing challenge.

methods.name: completeChallenge
methods.description: Marks a challenge as completed.

methods.name: submitValuesForChallenge
methods.description: Submits challenge values for validation and processing.

methods.name: setValidationStatusForChallenge
methods.description: Sets validation status for a challenge value and cleans up if finished.
